title: Enterprise account churn (ambiguous)
research_question: Why did the enterprise account most likely churn?
analyst_instructions: Read the evidence packet only. Do not discuss it with the other analyst. More than one interpretation may remain plausible; make uncertainty and alternative explanations explicit.
reviewer_instructions: Complete the prose-only baseline before opening Reviewer Matching. This case has no single designed correct answer. Grade the report against the paths as written, not against a hidden preferred conclusion.

evidence.text: The account's contract renewal quote increased 40% year over year.
Exit survey response: 'cost no longer matched the value we were getting, and support was slow toward the end.'
Support ticket volume for this account tripled in the final quarter.
A competitor announced a comparable product at a lower price two months before churn.
